title: FW↔DATA-001: Telemetry Schema Implementation + Schema-Change Coordination
description: Firmware emits telemetry conforming to the schema (correct units, sampling rates, timestamps, edge-buffering/backfill); Data supplies schema details and ingestion-driven constraints. Carries the joint Schema-Change Coordination Process (proposal → joint review ≤5 business days → ADR if breaking, Architect approver → implementation sequencing + transition window → edge-buffering semantics → Git/SemVer schema version registry). Grounded in FIRMWARE_ENGINEER_SKILL §6.8. (DATA §6 has no Firmware subsection; this edge is grounded from the FW side.)

schema_version.description: SemVer of the device telemetry schema (carried in the device header, validated by DATA at ingest).

units_conformant.description: All fields emitted with the schema-specified units.

edge_buffering_behavior.description: Edge buffering behavior on connectivity loss.

backward_compatible.description: False ⇒ must escalate to an ADR with the Architect as approver.

joint_review_due_date.description: Both roles review within 5 business days.

transition_window.description: Window during which both old and new schemas are accepted.

buffer_requirements_updated.description: True if the change affects device-side buffer capacity (shared edge-buffering responsibility).

x-macp.tier_rationale: Schema-conformant emission and backward-compatible changes are agent-autonomous. A backward-incompatible schema change escalates to an ADR with the Architect as approver (Tier-1/2).
x-macp.cadence: TRIGGER (schema alignment at planning; pipeline-integration checkpoints; schema-change joint review within 5 business days; schema-change ADR participation)
confirm_conditions: telemetry_implementation carries a SemVer schema_version and units_conformant = true
schema_version is registered in the organizational Git schema registry
a backward_compatible = true change carries changed_fields + a joint_review_due_date
a backward_compatible = false change carries an adr_ref and a transition_window
reject_conditions: backward-incompatible schema change without an ADR (Architect approver) — silent deviation forbidden
telemetry emitted with non-conformant units or no schema_version header
buffer-affecting change deployed without confirming DATA can ingest within the transition window
counter_conditions: new field increases payload beyond buffer capacity — request joint edge-buffering re-sizing before implementation
implementation order (FW emit vs. DATA ingest) unagreed — request a sequencing decision and transition window
